batch.description: Visual transcription of the AdmissionWar/Google Drive solved-paper compilation scan of the JU D4 Unit (Department of Pharmacy) 2013-2014 admission paper whose printed header reads Set CODE: 1 (Drive listing 'Set-5'). 60 questions: Bangla 8, English 7, Chemistry 20, Biology 15 (Botany 4, Zoology 11), Mathematics 10 — subjects assigned by content; the compilation prints no subject headings. Printed English directions (not questions): before Q9 'Direction: Each sentence has one or two blanks. Choose the answer choice that contains the word or words that best complete the sentence.'; before Q13 'Directions: Find the word most nearly same in meaning to the given word.'; before Q15 'Directions: Read the sentence carefully. Select the underlined part that is incorrect.' Keys are the compiler's printed উত্তরঃ boxes, not an official JU key; several printed keys are apparently wrong and are preserved as printed with flags (see ANSWERS.md). [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU D4 Unit (Department of Pharmacy), Faculty of Biological Sciences, 1st-year (Honours) admission test 2013-2014, Set CODE 1 — solved-paper compilation scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive)
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned solved-paper compilation (aggregator watermarks 'ADMISSION WAR' / AdmissionTech; footer 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com'; 'Scanned by CamScanner'). Every question is followed by a boxed উত্তরঃ key (Bangla letter), with ব্যাখ্যা boxes for some questions. 5 scanned pages; Q49-60 continue onto p.5. Drive filename 'ju-d-2013-2014-set5.pdf' / listing 'Set-5' vs printed header Set CODE: 1, D4 Unit (Pharmacy) — the printed header governs. Handwritten reader marks occur (a tick on Q20 option (ক)) and were NOT treated as keys. Renders: ocr/pages/jud1314s5/p-1..5.png (pdftoppm 300 dpi); p-1 render sha256 1af8dd3753c6b2a68cf04a1a9ae86cc5d880c56414e9a10e8c44ecfbfb84c42b; every key glyph was audited on enlarged key-box strips.

examRules.sourceNote: Transcribed from the compilation's printed header (PDF p.1): ফার্মেসী বিভাগ; ১ম বর্ষ (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা, ২০১৩-২০১৪; D 4-ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ; জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, সাভার; boxed set label 'Set CODE: 1'; সময় ৪৫ মিনিট; পূর্ণমান ৬০. বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্য (printed): প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে; প্রশ্নপত্রে উত্তর চিহ্নিত করা যাবে না; পরীক্ষার শুরুতেই OMR শিটের নির্ধারিত স্থানে দুটি বাক্য হুবহু লিখতে হবে — (ক) প্যারাসিটামলে জ্বর উপশম হয়। (খ) Propranolal is used in hypertension.
